_meta.purpose: Single-source rule registry (Shesha 0.45-only). Every mechanical fact lives HERE once; validators load this file and cite rule ids; prose docs cite [R-xxx] instead of restating. severity: fail = blocks push (machine-checked where check != null), warn = flagged, process = judgment/process rule enforced by the skill flow.
_meta.sources: knowledge/frontend-conventions.md, validate-guardrails.js, design-pipeline firm rules — consolidated 2026-07-22, deduped 2026-07-28
_meta.validatorField: validator names the script(s) that mechanically enforce the rule, relative to the shesha-form-edit skill root, else null. enforcement="practice" means the rule is a working practice with nothing to assert against a JSON tree; enforcement="unenforced" is a real gap. Docs may only use MUST/enforced/fail-closed language for a rule with a validator — scripts/lint-claims.mjs at the plugin root checks this.

rules.check: walker: every non-root component has parentId === direct parent id; root components carry parentId 'root'
rules.statement: Every component carries `parentId` set to its direct parent's `id` (root-level components get "root"). Missing parentId crashes the renderer with no useful error.

rules.check: walker: component id is a UUID or nanoid (≥10 chars, mixed alphabet) — short placeholder ids fail
rules.statement: Every component `id` is a generated unique id — a UUID or a nanoid (the 0.45 designer emits nanoids). Short human-typed placeholder ids (btn1, pr2) are silently ignored — the form renders blank.

rules.check: walker: component.version is an integer equal to the KB version for its type
rules.statement: Every component carries its type's CURRENT integer `version` from the 0.45 components-kb. No version → legacy render path (inputs render as read-only spans) or the migration chain re-runs and throws; a stale version SILENTLY DROPS the whole desktop style block.

rules.check: walker: propertyName (incl. datatable column propertyName) starts lowercase
rules.statement: Every `propertyName` is camelCase — including datatable column propertyNames. Metadata returns PascalCase paths but GQL field keys are camelCase; a PascalCase column fetches rows yet renders blank cells.

rules.check: walker: every datatable/datalist has a dataContext ancestor carrying entityType (string) + sourceType 'Entity'
rules.statement: The data wrapper for datatable/datalist is `dataContext` (v8) carrying explicit `entityType` (fullClassName STRING), `sourceType: "Entity"`, `dataFetchingMode: "paging"`, `defaultPageSize`, `uniqueStateId`, `componentName`, `propertyName`. It does NOT inherit from formSettings.modelType; a bare dataContext 500s on page load.

rules.check: walker: if any component has validate.required === true, a validationErrors component exists in the tree
rules.statement: A `validationErrors` component is ALWAYS in the tree (conventionally just above the action row) whenever the form has any required input — otherwise a failed submit renders nothing.

rules.check: walker: form actions only inside buttonGroup items; exactly one primary per group; Submit item carries actionName 'Submit' + actionOwner 'shesha.form'; Submit is paired with an exit (Navigate/Cancel) item
rules.statement: Form action buttons live in ONE `buttonGroup`, never standalone `button` components. Save/Submit MUST carry `actionConfiguration: { actionName: "Submit", actionOwner: "shesha.form" }` and be paired with an exit button (Back/Close/Cancel). Downstream tooling infers form intent from buttonGroup items — a mis-wired Submit misreads the whole form.

rules.check: walker: every Navigate action carries non-empty target/targetUrl
rules.statement: Every Navigate action carries a non-empty `target`/`targetUrl`. An empty target renders <Link href=undefined> and crashes the page. Mustache in targets must be resolvable in its runtime context ({{selectedRow.id}} on row actions, {{data.id}} on form actions).

rules.check: walker: defaultValue is absent or a string
rules.statement: `defaultValue` is a mustache-template STRING, never a literal array/number/object — the resolver calls `.match()` on it and a non-string throws `e.match is not a function`, killing the render. Multi-select defaults are bound through form data, never a literal array.

rules.check: walker: inline column editComponent/createComponent is [not-editable] or {type, settings:{...}} — never [default], never a flat model
rules.statement: Inline-editing column editors MUST be `{ "type": "[not-editable]" }` or `{ "type": "<editor>", "settings": { full component model with its own type+version+editMode+hideLabel } }`. `[default]` is only valid on displayComponent; a flat model without `settings` throws `reading 'version'`. Per-row CRUD needs a `columnType: "crud-operations"` column plus canEditInline/canAddInline/canDeleteInline: "yes".

rules.check: walker: checkboxGroup with dataSourceType 'values' uses items[] of {label,value}
rules.statement: `checkboxGroup` hardcoded options use `items` (NOT `values`), each `{label, value}`, with dataSourceType "values". dropdown/radio use `values` with `{id,label,value}` — do not conflate.

rules.check: walker: known code-carrying props are {_mode:'code',_code} objects, not raw strings
rules.statement: Code-mode props are objects `{ "_mode": "code", "_code": "..." }` — a code-carrying prop stored as a plain JS string is silently stripped on save.

rules.check: stringify round-trip of every script-carrying component
rules.statement: All embedded script strings must be JSON-safe: no template literals, no unescaped newlines, no smart quotes. A broken script string breaks the outer JSON with browser-side parse errors.

rules.check: grep: single-brace {expr} mustache in string props
rules.statement: Mustache expressions always use {{double braces}}. Single-brace expressions are silently ignored, producing empty values with no error.

rules.check: resolve-bindings: referenceListId matches the property's referenceListName/Module from live metadata; list exists with ≥1 item
rules.statement: A reference list's identity is READ from metadata, never guessed — `referenceListId.{module,name}` copied verbatim from the property's referenceListName/referenceListModule. A derived name renders a silently EMPTY dropdown.

rules.check: resolve-bindings: formSettings.modelType is the {name,module} object resolved from live EntityConfig; dataContext.entityType is the fullClassName string
rules.statement: On 0.45 `formSettings.modelType` is the `{ name, module }` OBJECT resolved from the live EntityConfig (never assumed); `dataContext.entityType` stays the fullClassName STRING. A namespace mismatch 500s at runtime.

rules.check: formSettings: entity-bound forms use gql loader/submitter unless a custom endpoint was explicitly requested
rules.statement: Entity-bound forms use the default `dataLoaderType/dataSubmitterType: "gql"`. Custom form-level endpoints are opt-in only — wired solely on explicit request and built via shesha-app-layer first.

`editMode` is per form type — never blanket-stamp. Detail forms with Start Edit/Submit lifecycle: "inherited". Create/edit dialogs and anonymous pages: "editable". Read-only rails/KIB strips: "readOnly" ("inherited" renders BLANK in the default view state). Visual components: omit.

"list"/"cards"/"feed"/"tiles" → `datalist`; "table"/"grid"/"spreadsheet" → `datatable`. Honor the user's noun; multi-select-from-a-list = selectionMode "multiple" on the datalist. Genuinely ambiguous → ask.

Minimal component count: the requested fields + validationErrors + ONE buttonGroup with Submit AND an exit button + minimum layout structure. The Submit/exit pair is part of the floor even for terse prompts; padding (extra containers, decorative panels, unrequested toolbar chrome) is a defect.

rules.check: walker: input components carry a label that differs from raw propertyName
rules.statement: Human-readable labels on every field — labels are user-facing AND how browser tests locate fields.

rules.check: formSettings: anonymous forms carry access 5
rules.statement: `access: 5` on anonymous forms (login, register, OTP); verify post-push by re-fetch.

rules.check: grep: globalState writes in scripts
rules.statement: No `globalState` for cross-form state — use `contexts.appContext` (app-wide) or `pageContext` (inter-page). localStorage/sessionStorage only for hard-refresh-surviving, non-sensitive state.

rules.check: grep: .then( chains / missing try-catch around http calls in scripts
rules.statement: API calls in embedded scripts use try/catch + async/await, never .then() chains.

rules.check: diff: ids of surviving components unchanged vs fetched markup
rules.statement: Preserve ids on existing components when editing — fresh GUIDs only on clones/new nodes.

API namespace is per service, never guessed: FormConfiguration under /api/services/Shesha/…; Metadata, Module, EntityConfig, ReferenceList under /api/services/app/…. A 404 usually means wrong namespace, not a missing resource.
UTF-8, BOM-free bytes for the cached token and every staged JSON file — a BOM poisons `Authorization: Bearer` and Node JSON.parse.

rules.check: walker: no `columns` component used for page-level splits; split containers set desktop.dimensions.width on children
rules.statement: Layout splits are flex-container children sized via `desktop.dimensions.width` (accepts % and calc()) — NEVER the Shesha `columns` component, never customStyle:{flex} (ignored), never style-channel flexShrink (never reaches the outer div).

rules.check: walker: a container with flex intent sets desktop.display 'flex' (the flex model lives in the desktop breakpoint block, not root)
rules.statement: A flex container MUST carry its flex model in the `desktop` breakpoint block — `desktop.{display:'flex', flexDirection, justifyContent, alignItems, gap, dimensions}`. The 0.45 renderer reads layout from `desktop.*`, NOT from root-level props; root-only display/flexDirection are inert and children stack (proven live). Sizing a split child = `desktop.dimensions.width` (+ `minWidth:'0px'` so flex items shrink instead of wrapping).

Appearance goes through desktop/tablet/mobile breakpoint blocks (the measured channels in measured-capability-matrix.json). background/shadow render only as COMPLETE objects (background needs `type`; partial sub-path writes are dead — gym-measured). The legacy `style` JS-string renders inline and WINS over everything — when a stamped prop doesn't render, grep the component and its ancestors for a truthy `style` first.

rules.check: walker: customVisibility absent; conditional visibility via code-mode hidden
rules.statement: Conditional visibility = code-mode `hidden` ({_mode:"code",_code:"return !(data?.x)"} — TRUE hides). Legacy `customVisibility` is IGNORED on 0.45. Use optional chaining: create forms have no data context initially and a throw fails-open.

A container renders TWO divs: the outer (sha-components-container, the flex item) receives only dimensions+shadow; layout props land on the inner. Inner overflow is hard-coded `overflow:auto` — the model's overflow prop is a no-op; fix squeezed headers with `dimensions.minHeight: "fit-content"`.
Field-level `labelCol` is ignored — only formSettings.labelCol/wrapperCol applies (field-level labelAlign IS honored). `.sha-page-content:not(.no-padding)` carries a hard-coded 12px inset.

rules.check: resolve-bindings: every bound propertyName exists on the modelType (live metadata), dotted paths resolved segment-wise
rules.statement: A bound value renders ONLY when `propertyName` is a real entity property — it drives the gql fetch. Mutating data in onAfterDataLoad or form.setFieldsValue does NOT populate a read-only field's display.
Mustache {{ }} HTML-escapes ' & < > — use {{{triple-brace}}} for trusted display values. GUIDs are unaffected.
`refListStatus` fill colour comes ONLY from the reference-list item's own colour — no item colour = grey regardless of solidBackground. Radius via desktop.border.radius.all, never customStyle.

rules.check: grep: onPrepareSubmitData reduces FK objects to {id}
rules.statement: Dynamic CRUD Update rejects an FK sent as a nested object ("not allowed to be updated") — reduce every FK to `{ id }` in formSettings.onPrepareSubmitData.

Execute Script actions must return a Promise (no IIFEs); `http.get(url,{params})` drops params — query args go in the URL string; formArguments/selectedRows are NOT in Execute Script scope (multiselect via the context's selectedIds).

0.45 lifecycle: `onInitialized` is NOT wired on dynamic pages — custom data loading goes through `onAfterDataLoad` (async-capable). `dataLoaderType: "custom"` is silently skipped whenever the page supplies initialValues (DynamicPage always does).

Plan ALL backend changes up front and apply in ONE build + double-boot: a NEW entity needs TWO boots (its CRUD controller registers on the boot after EntityConfig seeds); reflist items + app-service code need one. Verify entity CRUD Create returns 200 BEFORE authoring the form.

NEVER expose raw entity CRUD to the anonymous internet. Public-form writes go through a custom [AbpAllowAnonymous] app service that forces server-side values and re-enforces validation; the form Submit posts to it via Execute Script, then Navigates.

rules.check: validate-styledness.js exit code
rules.statement: No form ships unstyled. A structurally-complete default-grey form is a defect — every no-design build ends with the shipped `shesha` theme applied via shesha-design-system before push (skipped only by explicit --no-style).

CRUD wiring is canonical: table Add = buttonGroup item with Show Dialog (modal, formId {name,module}, modalWidth 60%, formMode edit) — never Navigate; detail lifecycle = Start Edit / Submit / Cancel Edit (owner shesha.form); standalone create/edit page = Save (Submit, primary) + Back (Navigate); toolbar Refresh/Toggle Columns use the dataContext component's id as actionOwner; row→detail = action column navigate to /dynamic/<module>/<form>?id={{selectedRow.id}}.

rules.check: walker: no actionName 'Delete row' with owner 'table'
rules.statement: Row delete/unlink = Execute Script + `await http.delete(...)` + onSuccess Refresh table with actionOwner = the dataContext component id. `Delete row`/owner "table" does not exist and throws.

Contextually-preset required FKs on create dialogs need BOTH a real bound component AND formSettings.onPrepareSubmitData — formArguments/setFieldsValue alone never reach the submit payload. Omission = Crud/Create 500.

rules.check: Stop hook: push-ledger entries all verified/abandoned
rules.statement: A validated file on disk is NOT a delivered form. Every authored form is pushed to the backend and verified (re-fetch + diff) before the task is reported done — enforced by the push-ledger Stop hook.

Verification = re-fetch the pushed form and diff against what was sent; the 200 alone proves nothing. Browser checks clear the IndexedDB form cache and navigate table→details (never a hand-built ?id= URL).

Datalist row-template cards: name-mode bound text, `dimensions: fit-content`, single-line ellipsis for long text, status chip on its own row, padding/overflow via the legacy `style` prop, card height "auto" — the collapse/overflow fix lives in the block subtree.

Component versions are framework-release-specific and DRIFT across point releases. The 0.45 components-kb (_index.json) is authoritative for this plugin; when exactness matters probe a live form on the target backend. Version facts are the only cross-generation knowledge kept here — 0.43 authoring lives in the shesha-developer-0-43 plugin.
Never read a whole large seed/golden form — grep the fragment you need. Whole-file reads of 100KB+ markup are the top context-burn failure.
